sources.title: Medical-AI-Assistant/models/medical-lora-model at main - GitHub
sources.snippet: A full-stack Medical AI Assistant chatbot built with FastAPI (backend) and React/Vite (frontend). It leverages a fine-tuned LLM (via HuggingFace + PEFT/LoRA) to answer medical queries with contextual memory. Features include JWT-based user authentication, secure password hashing, and a real-time chat interface.

sources.title: GitHub - satyamshivam13/LoRA_Medical_QA_Finetune: Reproducible LoRA ...
sources.snippet: A clean, reproducible LoRA (parameter-efficient) fine-tuning pipeline that adapts Llama 3.2 1B Instruct to medical question-answering — with honest before/after evaluation on a free GPU. ⚕️ Disclaimer: This is an educational demonstration of fine-tuning. Model outputs are not medical advice. Do not use for diagnosis or treatment.
